output.reason: The changelog line [ev-9e92c97ef99e] is brief, but the linked PR [ev-b1f2216cec21] states the change concretely. Traefik's service health check gains opt-in gRPC support, based on the gRPC Health Checking Protocol v1, so Traefik stops routing to unhealthy gRPC backends. Per [ev-239f308d0b10] and [ev-4839c1c856eb], it is turned on through a new health-check option in the HTTP service configuration (http_config.go and the dynamic-config references). Exposure is therefore limited to services whose health check is set to the gRPC mode, and nothing in the evidence says existing setups change. The only gap is the exact key name: the PR mentions both a "grpc" scheme and a "dedicated mode option", so confidence is low.
